quests.title: Does the Cork Route Still Run?
quests.summary: A resident of Belfast wants to know if the way to Cork is still open, and has not bothered to check.

steps.text: Ask a local in Cork about the road.
steps.line: Shut? Never. There was a sheep on it for a week, that's all. Tell them to come on up.
Open! And only a sheep. I'll ring round. Thank you, there's a little something for you.

start.ask: Look, someone said the way through to Cork is shut. I've a cousin there and I'd like to know. Could you look in?
start.accept: You're a star. I'll put the kettle on for when you're back.

quests.title: What's It Doing in Dublin?
quests.summary: A resident of Cork is planning a trip and wants a straight answer on the weather in Dublin.

steps.line: The weather? Oh, it's four seasons before lunch. Tell them to bring a coat and a sense of humour.
A coat and a sense of humour. I'll take both. That's the most useful forecast I've had all year.

start.ask: Look, I'm thinking of a day trip to Dublin but I don't trust the forecast. Would you go and look at the sky for me?
start.accept: Look up. Report honestly. I'll dress accordingly.
